full_text:
SUBJECT: FINAL NOTICE & DEMAND FOR COMPLIANCE
RE: Request to Amend PHI (DOS: 2/16/26)

I am rejecting your March 30, 2026 letter. My form was not filled out in error. It was filled out deliberately and precisely to exercise my federal rights under 45 CFR § 164.526. To be absolutely clear: I am intentionally declining to file a 'Statement of Disagreement'... By checking that box, I am exercising my rights—as explicitly outlined in your own March 16 correspondence—to demand the following: You are required to include my original amendment request and your denial along with all future disclosures of my medical record.
